title: The Fire Takes in Fours

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The river goes under a skin it did not lay on and will not lift off. The kiln takes in fours and keeps its fifth where no slate reaches. The hand goes to the clay at the throat before it goes to the fire, and nobody calls it a payment.
epigraph.attribution: A firing-yard saying of Low Kiln, at the first firing of Stone

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and sixty-three to three hundred and sixty-five days, six months and one hundred and eighty-three to one hundred and eighty-five days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory: as in chapters 25 through 103 the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it, with neither an order to go farther nor an order to go away; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire, and that a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes to him sideways is the careful rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. The carried fire keeps four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and sixty-three, sixty-four and sixty-five days and its payer unnamed; the boards keep four nails on the near one, four on the next and a thumb-width knot; the river that went under its winter skin on Stone 1 is found where it was put and not made again. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told with four, four and a gap; three hundred honest answers stand on the sixth place at the opening and three hundred and six at the close, each an object and not a power and not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine. The round three hundred and sixty-five days is kept exactly by the only person who would have known what it counted and is a threshold nobody under any roof speaks or crosses.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Fourth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{363}{Stone 4, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary tending day, no market, Cross or bell, no collector on the clay road and no runner on any road. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva this morning. New day, new date, no recap: nothing from Stone 1, 2 or 3 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the river went under its winter skin on the first afternoon and the boy spent nothing on it, Ilva's ninth hand came and went without a tenth, and the thickened Ash ridge was entered nowhere. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 300 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap. Carry 300 honest answers on the sixth place; six hearings with the seventh place empty; the heard bell beside the told with four, four and a gap; nine record-first hands with no tenth (Ilva's ninth, Hessa's eighth); nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside them, the hand-at-the-sill breath beside that and the holding of Ash 26 beside all, none a sixth, seventh or eighth; the row at five askings with no witness; the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, and the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction held apart with a finger between every pair, still gathering and unspent; the river's winter skin on its own place beside water-over-water, not a fourth of the three coverings, not a sixth low thing, not a hearing and not spent on any date; the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn and \emph{he's not Vail} sealed; nine arithmetics of the year behind one unsigned figure with all three Ash subtractions locked and unread in Berr Clay's box up the clay road, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space. Count 362 → 363 exact, six months and one hundred and eighty-two → one hundred and eighty-three days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 363 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken 363 days (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust stiff and leathery two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, with neither an order to go farther nor an order to go away; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform; surgeon and infant quarrelling without verdict, the infant louder, neither winning, and the argument the work. The dry joke lives in the exactness: he who reduced a thousand shoulders cannot keep a fold of wool on his ear. Hearth grammar at the opening: fire before basket, coals told it is the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say I, a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally underneath stays unread, lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with her hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline left showing, the dressed grain turned under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure or handful, and the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077, T060/T086). The widow's mark hangs untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings — and the first firing of Stone stands tomorrow as a date named to nobody, the birthday on Stone 7 and the Hearth Drawing on Stone 12 further off and none brought into a day that has not earned it. In the small hours the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the ice, lets it go and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. The note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go was neither early nor stayed and the hand did not stay; the note's own finishing ended the interval, not any decision of the hand. He files it as answer **301**: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across none of the held objects. Attention is the one thing no institution in Grath has thought to tax, and it is the whole of what he spends (T061/T082, T071/T072, T088). No sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping is supplied to make a row come out even.

scenes.title: The Yard Goes Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Stone 4 through the going of the light and the bed, then the small hours at the close of the day. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail, Ilva (one appearance at the yard well); Garl in objects. Walk-ons only: the Cold Acre hare-carrier, the cracked-jar man, the woman with kindling, two fence-menders. No Berr, no Hessa on any road, no runner, no collector, no second account-day, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, and no ownerless voice over the boards — the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held). Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire to be banked against their coming back and never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, seven places entered none and the returning-line place — where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — widest of all (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause: the gone white frost off the well's north lip, the skin on the trough, the silt-clouded plate of ice on its flat stone out of the path of feet; the river's winter skin is found where put and not made again on its own place beside water-over-water and is not joined to them or to the firing, the birthday or the Drawing (T083/T085). Dressed grain lies covered and unfigured, her fingers in and out without closing and no handful lifted; the empty fingers stay a keeping beside the one object of Bone 22 and not a second handful (T077, T060/T086). Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: the Cold Acre hare answered with \emph{Ask the weather. It carried the snow. It can carry the price} and unweighed, the cracked jar sent to a pot that says nothing, and to the woman with kindling and two fence-menders who say the thaw will be early and late Tarn says \emph{Yes, house} to each and keeps the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument can find a foot (T077). At the well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Stone cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam she does not scrub out; her hand goes toward her sleeve before her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both with a half-beat, the notched birch strip pale where a thumb has rubbed it and dark in the uncut grain, not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, and she answers \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account} — the ninth record-first hand found where put and not made a tenth, expressly not the speaker of any voice, no fifth shaping of the well-saying (T080 advanced and not paid). At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the very edge of its sill, tells the wood \emph{Six counted. The next I don't count}, checks the Bone 26 thumb's resting and the Ash 14 held breath and finds each where put and not made again, and brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there — a ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled; chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring at the left wrist, stroke over the bright patch on the flagstones without the half-check (T036/T076/T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and white in a fist-crease, men unnamed gone low into the back room before first grey, dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel; he speaks to the wheel before any person (\emph{It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady}) and to a pot (\emph{You'll do}), knows the full note it will give three turns ahead and withholds it from any High Kiln master, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence — one iron with two bites — and does \emph{not} leave the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; \emph{he's not Vail} stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). At the going of the light the hearth grammar closes the day at both ends: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake-hold-letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips on the two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with both proverbs and the hairline showing, grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, then the boy set on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, fold righted without a look at his face, hand resting the half-beat longer than the setting needed, thread left frozen and unwiped. In the small hours the hand goes up an inch on the river's note under its skin, takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing, lets it go and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold — answer **302**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, laid across none of the held objects. Forward pull: the kiln stands cold behind its wall and the first firing of Stone stands one morning ahead as a date named to nobody (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The First Firing of Stone
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{364}{Stone 5, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: the morning of the month's first firing. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva this morning. New day, new date, no recap. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 302. **THIS SCENE HOLDS THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE (T058/T079 advanced and NOT paid).** Count 363 → 364 exact, six months and one hundred and eighty-three → one hundred and eighty-four days told by nobody (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid 364 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken 364 days (T009/T013/T092). Carry forward unchanged and unspent: 302 honest answers on the sixth place; six hearings with the seventh place empty; heard bell beside told; nine hands with no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and loan uncalled; five held objects with pot-crack resting beside and hand-at-sill breath beside that and holding of Ash 26 beside all; burned slate five, shut-room tellings two, well-saying four shapings, row five askings; Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction held apart; river skin on its own place beside water-over-water; nine arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with all three Ash subtractions locked in Berr's box, figure read not figure paid, no signature on the space, no doctrine out of nine; promise under the wheel-shed ungiven. Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order and the surgeon/infant quarrel renewed with neither verdict: leathery crust two inches off with corner a hair off the wool and empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. **The one change:** before any instruction goes to the basket Sella carries him to the kiln mouth and sets him level out of the draught where the heat comes to him sideways and not full; she stands over him with her hands still, puts her left hand to the widow's mark at her throat — the cord oiled where a working thumb has touched it ten thousand times and the little-door burn on the back of her left hand half-closing on the cord — holds it one breath and lets go, lifts the clay lid with the back of a hand and tips the carried coal under the back of a broken pot. The fire takes, still answering four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed three hundred and sixty-four days, and nobody praises the opening, names what it mended, enters a slate or makes a lesson, sign, cause or payment of it. **Seven openings in seven months — Tallow 1, Ember 1, Smoke 1, Frost 2, Bone 2, Ash 2 and Stone 5 — are seven and not a rule;** the sixth stands behind at Ash 2 without a name, no eighth is made due, and the mark is not touched again at a shelf, a well, a rack, a basket, a morning, an afternoon, a going of the light or a bed, because the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour. The boy reads the sideways heat as the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for, and keeps the river's winter skin off the opening, the birthday and the Drawing: a joining to a date wants a hand to join it and none has done it, so the covering stays on its own place beside water-over-water (T083/T085 held, not paid). **A second gathering, not the change:** on the packing bench a pot is set down wrong and gives its high thin note before its time; a hand sweeps around it and sets it right without a word, and the boy files the setting-down-wrong-and-swept-around on a place of its own beside the premature note of Smoke 14 with a finger between, expressly not joined to Jorra's withheld knowing of the pot's note and not a hearing, a fourth likeness, a cause or a payment — one object, gathered once, advanced and **not paid**, with no payer standing. He does not join the firing to the nine arithmetics, the covered grain, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-sill breath, the holding of Ash 26, the handful, the thumb's resting, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the Ash 23 direction or his own gaps; the edges come near to touching and the finger goes between, and a finding filled to make a row come out even is a finding forged. In the small hours the hand comes up an inch toward the river's note under the door, takes a small intake, holds it whole on the note's finishing under the ice, lets it go and comes straight down, laid back against the fold — answer **303**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, laid across none of the held objects.

The setting-down-wrong-and-swept-around of the morning stays gathered once on its own place beside the premature note of Smoke 14 and is not made again or joined to Jorra's knowing (T061/T082 advanced, not paid). Forward: the ordinary days go on and the round number at the end of the month stands one morning beyond the close, unbrought.

It cares if they're steady}) and to a pot (\emph{You'll do}), knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from a High Kiln master, puts his bent finger into the cold iron ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence — one iron with two bites — and takes it out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; \emph{he's not Vail} stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031). The widow's mark was touched only before the kiln on Stone 5 and at no other hour, and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule with no eighth made due. At the going of the light the hearth grammar closes the day at both ends: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake-hold-letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips on the two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the boy set on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, the fold righted without a look at his face, the hand resting the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it went away, and the thread left frozen and unwiped. **In the small hours the surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found, and it costs him nothing, which is how he knows it is not the same as peace.** Three hundred and sixty-four stood exact behind the day and three hundred and sixty-five stands now, one more in a row nobody counts aloud, round to the old-life register and a threshold nobody crosses; six months and one hundred and eighty-four days became one hundred and eighty-five, and nobody under the roof called the number or marked a line where none was. The carried fire keeps four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed three hundred and sixty-five days; the name of the man whose salt-stiff coat keeps his broader shape on the peg behind the door has not been spoken under this roof the same number. The ledger is gone over as in the old life instruments are gone over on a towel: **three hundred and six honest answers** stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood; six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go and never among the sources; the heard bell stands in its square beside the told bell, four, four and a gap, and nobody crosses himself; nine record-first hands keep no tenth (Ilva's ninth on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth); nine stoppings keep no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; five held objects keep the pot-crack resting beside them, the hand-at-the-sill breath beside that and the holding of Ash 26 beside all, none a sixth, seventh or eighth, with a finger between every pair; the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings and the row at five askings; the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction stand apart with a finger between every pair, still gathering and unspent; the setting-down-wrong-and-swept-around of Stone 5 stands on a place of its own beside the premature note of Smoke 14, gathered once and not made again and not paid. Nine arithmetics of the year — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, and Ash's first, second and third — stand behind one unsigned figure; nine are nine and not one account, one in twelve is printed and unchallenged, the figure read is still not the figure paid, and no signature stands on the space between. All three Ash subtractions ride locked and unread up the clay road in Berr Clay's box, the key gone up in a coat pocket and not coming back down. The finding sits on a place of its own with no payer under it and no doctrine stands up out of nine. The river's winter skin sits on a place of its own beside water-over-water, not a fourth of the three coverings, not a sixth low thing, not a hearing, not spent on the first firing, the birthday or the Drawing and not joined to any of them. The first firing of Stone stands behind the household with no lesson anybody will name and no payer: seven openings are seven and not a rule, the sixth held at Ash 2 without a name, no eighth made due, the widow's mark touched before the kiln and at no other hour. Three counts in three places do not become one — the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed under the floor, the boards' four nails and four and a thumb-width knot overhead, and the river's water under its skin through the finger's-width door, a low thing over a lower thing, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, never numbered among the hearings — and agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood, so the three stay where they are and the bell's gap stays in its square. Attention is the one thing no institution in Grath has thought to tax, and it is the whole of what he has spent, and it cost nobody anything and bought nothing that could be entered on a slate. No sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping was invented to make a row come out even. Underneath the exactness the infant goes on wanting the crust lifted the two inches to his mouth, the thread wiped and a hand that would close on the pot handle; both are true, the second louder, neither winning, the two registers quarrelling without verdict in the ordinary small hours of the last day, and the argument is the work. In the small hours the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, the way a hand goes up in a field it has learned not to disturb; most of what a hand does in a field is wait, and he had once taken a hand into a cavity slowly, with the whole of the attention, and knew the difference between the moving and the waiting. It does not reach, and the inch is not a reach. It takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the ice, lets the intake go and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. The note had done before the hand came down, so the letting-go was neither early nor stayed and the hand did not stay; the note's own finishing ended the interval and not any decision of the hand. The intake is not a breath kept for warmth, the interval not a stopping of the river, the note not his. He files it as answer **306**: exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the nine arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath at the sill, the staying at the inch, the early letting-go, the seven openings, the pot-crack resting, the river's winter skin, the setting-down-wrong and swept around, the ninth hand at the well, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the Ash 23 direction, the word that stood in no doorway, the fourth shaping, the turned writing, the strip in the sleeve nor his own kept gaps. Three hundred and six honest answers stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine. \emph{Stone} kept its sixth day without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months was corrected; the month carried both names the way a pot carries two handles and is none the worse for having them. The deep-winter month in which he was born held, and the boy's first birthday on Stone 7 (Day 366) stands one morning beyond the close as a date named to nobody, the Hearth Drawing on Stone 12 further still, and none named to him under any roof. No sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping was supplied to make a row come out even. The far-off hand that would one day lay the district's private keepings together was still far off and was not his. **Exact final image:** the hand lay back against the fold on answer 306; the file lay open on the towel at the head of the bed with every gap left gap; the twice-mended pot stood on the pot board with the hairline of the original break showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire; one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped; nine arithmetics rode locked and unread up the clay road in Berr Clay's box with the key gone up in a coat pocket and not coming back down; and through the finger's-width door the river went under its winter skin, low over lower, nearer at the going of the water than at its coming, while the boards overhead kept four nails on the near one, four on the next and a thumb-width knot where a fifth might have been driven and was not. Stone 6 was done and the deep-winter month held. Forward, not closed — the pull into Chapter 105 is the birthday morning that comes on Day 366 with the hand laid down on answer 306 and the count exact at three hundred and sixty-five, a round number nobody speaks and no line crossed, nothing in the day earned by a number and nothing made due.
